note: Prototype rules on simulated data. Thresholds are demo assumptions chosen so a replay shows each rule within minutes; they are not published Caterpillar limits and must not protect people on a real machine.

rules.message: Seatbelt unfastened while the engine is running (simulated).
rules.reason: The engine was running while the seatbelt was unfastened.
rules.recommended_action: Fasten your seatbelt before moving or operating the machine.
rules.start_speech: Warning: the engine is running and your seatbelt is not fastened. Please fasten your seatbelt.
rules.clear_speech: Thanks, your seatbelt is fastened. The seatbelt warning is cleared.

rules.message: Engine idling for a prolonged period (simulated).
rules.reason: The engine kept idling past the demo idle limit.
rules.recommended_action: If you are waiting, tell me why; otherwise shut the engine down to save fuel.
rules.start_speech: You've been idling for over five minutes. If you're waiting, tell me why; otherwise consider shutting the engine down.

rules.reason: The machine idled with the engine on and the seatbelt unfastened past the demo limit.
rules.recommended_action: Fasten your seatbelt while you wait in the cab.
rules.start_speech: You're idling with your seatbelt unfastened. Please fasten it while you wait.
